name: claude-todo
description: Capture ideas while Claude works, then pick them back up. /todo <text> records an idea without costing a turn; /todo on its own opens a picker over what is still open.

todo_file.title: Todo file
todo_file.description: Where the todo list lives. Relative paths resolve against the project root.

todo_editor.title: Editor command
todo_editor.description: Editor used by the Edit action, overriding $VISUAL and $EDITOR. Example: nvim --clean
